# AX.25 over FM, 1200 baud

Two AX.25 UI frames, Bell 202 AFSK at 1200 baud, narrowband FM at 3 kHz deviation,
96 kS/s complex on 144.390 MHz — the APRS channel in North America.

**Nobody transmitted this.** It is generated by `fixtures/make.mjs` from a fixed seed,
using the modulators in `web/test/support/modulate.mjs`, which are the inverse of the
decoders they feed: HDLC bit stuffing, NRZI, a CRC-16/X.25 frame check, and
continuous-phase FSK. The callsigns are `N0CALL` (reserved for exactly this) and
`KC1ABC`, which is not a real station's traffic either way. Regenerating produces a
byte-identical file, so a diff here means a change in `make.mjs`.

The check is two-sided on purpose: if the modulator drifts, direwolf and multimon-ng
stop agreeing with it and say so. A modulator that is wrong in the same way as the
decoder it feeds would be a test of nothing, and these were written against neither —
they were written against the specification and then checked against both programs.
